def diff_out(lb,rb):
    best=None
    H=max(lb.shape[0],rb.shape[0])+4;W=max(lb.shape[1],rb.shape[1])+4
    P=np.zeros((H,W),int);P[:lb.shape[0],:lb.shape[1]]=lb
    for dy in range(-4,5):
        for dx in range(-4,5):
            Q=np.zeros((H,W),int)
            src=rb
            y0,x0=dy,dx
            if y0<0 or x0<0 or y0+src.shape[0]>H or x0+src.shape[1]>W: continue
            Q[y0:y0+src.shape[0],x0:x0+src.shape[1]]=src
            d=(P>0)!=(Q>0)
            n=d.sum()
            if best is None or n<best[0]: best=(n,d)
    n,d=best
    ys,xs=np.nonzero(d)
    return d[ys.min():ys.max()+1,xs.min():xs.max()+1].astype(int)*8, n
